units.source_text: 天色渐暮，髭黑大将心不在焉，巴不得早点来到玉鬘那里。

en.t: As dusk gradually fell, the Higekuro General was distracted, longing to get to Tamakazura as soon as possible.

units.source_text: 可巧天上降下大雪。

en.t: Just then, heavy snow began falling from the sky.

units.source_text: 这种天气定要出门，旁人看了必然诧怪。

en.t: If he insisted on going out in such weather, anyone who saw him would surely find it strange.

units.source_text: 眼前这个人如果嫉妒怨恨，气色难堪，倒可以此为借口，反唇相讥，拂袖而去。

en.t: If the woman before him had shown jealousy and resentment, with an ugly expression, he could have used that as an excuse, answered her sharply, and swept away.

units.source_text: 无奈现在她却平心静气，和蔼可亲，抛弃她实甚可怜。

en.t: But now she was calm, gentle, and affectionate, and it seemed truly pitiful to abandon her.

units.source_text: 到底如何是好，心思迷惑不定。

en.t: He could not decide what he ought to do, and his thoughts wavered in confusion.

units.source_text: 于是格子窗也不关，只管坐在窗前望着庭中出神。

en.t: So he left the lattice window open and simply sat before it, staring blankly into the garden.

units.source_text: 夫人看了他这模样，便催他出门：“真不巧啊，雪下得这么大。

en.t: Seeing him like this, his wife urged him to leave: "How unfortunate, with the snow falling so heavily.

units.source_text: 路上很难走呢。

en.t: The road must be very hard to travel.

units.source_text: 天色也不早了。”

en.t: And it is no longer early."

units.source_text: 她知道情缘今已断绝，挽留也是枉然，那神情十分可怜。

en.t: She knew that their bond was now broken and that trying to keep him back would be useless, and her expression was deeply pitiful.

units.source_text: 髭黑大将说：“这种天气怎么出门呢！”

en.t: The Higekuro General said, "How could anyone go out in weather like this?"

units.source_text: 但话又说回来：“不过在最近期间，那边的人还没有知道我的心，都要说长道短。

en.t: But then he added, "Still, for the time being, the people there do not yet understand my feelings and will surely gossip.

units.source_text: 太政大臣和内大臣听了左右的话，也会对我怀疑。

en.t: If the Chancellor and the Minister of the Left hear what people around them are saying, they too will become suspicious of me.

units.source_text: 所以我还是不得不去。

en.t: So I still have no choice but to go.

units.source_text: 请你心平气和地观察我吧。

en.t: Please watch me calmly and without anger.

units.source_text: 等她迁到这里之后，大家都可安心了。

en.t: Once she has moved here, everyone will be able to feel at ease.

units.source_text: 在你这样清醒的时候，我决不会想念别人，只觉得你很可怜爱。”

en.t: When you are as clear-minded as this, I will never think of anyone else; I only feel how dear and pitiful you are."

units.source_text: 夫人低声下气地答道：“如果你这人留在家里，而你的心向着外面，反而使我痛苦；

en.t: His wife answered humbly and softly, "If your body stays at home while your heart is turned elsewhere, that only makes me suffer more;

units.source_text: 如果你这人在别处，而你的心能想念我，那么我袖上的冰也会融解了。”

en.t: but if your body is somewhere else and your heart can still think of me, then even the ice on my sleeves would melt."

units.source_text: 便取过香炉来，替髭黑大将的衣服熏上浓香。

en.t: Then she brought over an incense burner and scented the Higekuro General's robes with a rich fragrance.

units.source_text: 她自己身上却穿着不浆的旧衣服，落拓不羁，姿态更加显得寒酸。

en.t: She herself, however, wore old unstarched clothes, looking disheveled and unrestrained, which made her appearance seem even more shabby.

units.source_text: 那消沉之相，叫人看了非常难过。

en.t: Her dejected look was extremely painful to see.

units.source_text: 由于时时哭泣，两眼均已红肿，相貌不免逊色。

en.t: Because she had been crying so often, both her eyes were already red and swollen, and her beauty had inevitably faded somewhat.

units.source_text: 但此时髭黑大将真心地可怜她，所以并不觉得难看。

en.t: But at this moment the Higekuro General truly pitied her, and so he did not find her unattractive.

units.source_text: 他想起同她做了多年夫妻，而忽把爱情完全移到别人身上，觉得自己太薄幸了。

en.t: Remembering that he had been her husband for many years, and that he had suddenly shifted all his love to someone else, he felt that he had been terribly heartless.

units.source_text: 但同时又觉得对玉鬘的热恋依然旺盛。

en.t: At the same time, however, he felt that his passionate love for Tamakazura was still as strong as ever.

units.source_text: 便假装懒洋洋的样子，叹息数声，把衣服换上，又取过小香炉来塞在衣袖里，再加熏香。

en.t: So he pretended to be languid, sighed several times, changed his robes, then took a small incense burner and tucked it into his sleeve to perfume them further.
